properties.bedrock_type: Carboniferous Lower Oil-Shale Sandstone / Gullane Formation
properties.mineralogy: Fine-to-medium grained quartz-rich Craigleith/Hailes sandstone with interbedded siltstone and mudstone
properties.drainage: Well-drained gentle urban glacial till over bedrock, directing subterranean run-off southward toward the Meadows basin

properties.primary_surfacing: Dense asphalt roadway flanked by Caithness stone slab pavements and granite kerbstones
properties.wear_characteristics: Polished asphalt tire lanes with minor bitumen patching, hairline pavement joint cracking, and recessed cast-iron drainage gratings
properties.micro_grading: Gradual southward downward slope along Leven Street toward Bruntsfield Place

properties.groundcover: Cultivated tree pit grates and sparse mosses in shaded stone reveals

properties.primary_building_typology: Victorian Scottish Baronial / Gothic Revival Church and 4-storey Classical Tenements

structures.name: Barclay Viewforth Church (Barclay Memorial Church)
structures.roof_geometry: Steeply pitched multi-gabled slate roofs with colossal southwest stone spire rising to 250ft (76m)
structures.facade_material: Rough-hewn squared snecked sandstone rubble with fine polished ashlar dressings and carved Gothic tracery
structures.weathering_patina: Pronounced dark soot-crusted carbon patina in sheltered lancet window reveals and deep cornice undercuts, contrasting with rain-washed ashlar quoins

structures.name: East Street-Wall Tenements (Leven Street / Home Street)
structures.roof_geometry: Pitched Scottish slate with prominent stone chimney stacks and lead flashings
structures.facade_material: Blonde and grey Craigleith/Hailes sandstone ashlar with ground-floor commercial frontages
structures.weathering_patina: Historical coal-smoke blackening around upper storeys, weathered lime mortar repointing, and oxidized cast-iron rainwater downpipes

structures.name: West Street-Wall Tenements (Leven Street)
structures.roof_geometry: Pitched slate with dormer projections and ashlar skews
structures.facade_material: Coursed sandstone ashlar with continuous string courses and rusticated ground-floor masonry
structures.weathering_patina: Vertical water run-off staining beneath sills and dark carbon deposits across deep eaves

pedestrian_profiles: Commuters and local residents in casual outerwear traversing sidewalks

properties.lighting_condition: Warm Golden Hour with low-angled raking amber sunlight casting long eastward shadows across the roadway
